project.name: Calloway Street apartments, 18-22 Calloway Street, West Ryde
project.summary: A new six-storey residential flat building of 64 apartments (NCC Class 2) over two basement levels of car parking (Class 7a) on three amalgamated R4 lots in West Ryde, replacing three 1962 dwellings. DA to the City of Ryde determined by the Ryde Local Planning Panel, then full construction documentation by the developer's consultants and a lump-sum tender under AS 4000, with no novation; construction budget $27,600,000 ex GST.

firms: Kestrel Bridge Structural Engineers Pty Ltd
streets: 18-22 Calloway Street, West Ryde (invented street in a real suburb)

Daniel Okafor of Tallis Grove Developments writes on 2 March 2026 (Subject: Program for the Calloway Street apartments), stating the target start sentence and asking whether it is realistic.
